about_the_game:
Welcome to Ultimate Hunting®, where you get a taste of the hunt in a limited but action-packed experience. Explore a 4 km² stretch of the African savanna, track elusive game, and test your skills in three short missions.

Features in the Demo:

  • Hunt Three Animal Species: Elephant, warthog, and kudu roam the demo's landscape, offering different hunting challenges.

  • Fully Functional Mechanics: Use the Plant Atlas and Game Atlas, customize your rifle, use lures, and track animals with realistic AI.

  • Drive & Transport: Navigate the terrain in a vehicle and transport your harvested trophies.

  • Multiplayer Co-op: Hunt alone or join up to three friends in online multiplayer. Coordinate strategies, take on missions together, and experience the wild as a team.

  • Ethical Hunting Rules: Be mindful of your targets—hunting young animals has consequences, and repeated offenses can label you a poacher.

This is just the beginning. Experience the core gameplay, mechanics, and immersive atmosphere before diving into the full version of Ultimate Hunting® with even larger maps, expanded gear, and up to 4-player multiplayer action!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 2060 or AMD Radeon™ RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7600K or AMD Ryzen™ 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 3070 or AMD Radeon™ RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Embark on a 4 km² African savanna in the Ultimate Hunting® Demo. Track, spot, and hunt three iconic species, complete three missions, and transport trophies by vehicle. Customize your rifle, join up to four players, and explore the Plant & Game Atlases - your safari begins!
